body:
I would not expect this to be possible: Unless another thread is concurrenly modifying the physics system and removing bodies then all bodies returned by `GetActiveBodiesUnsafe` should be valid bodies.

I'm not really sure what `pre_step` does, but if it triggers some kind of user callback that can activate/deactivate bodies then `GetActiveBodiesUnsafe` is truly unsafe as it will be modified while iterating over the list.

> I would not expect this to be possible: Unless another thread is concurrenly modifying the physics system and removing bodies then all bodies returned by `GetActiveBodiesUnsafe` should be valid bodies.

Great, thank you, I wasn't sure what the exact conditions were for them being invalid. I've gone ahead and removed the checks

> I'm not really sure what `pre_step` does, but if it triggers some kind of user callback that can activate/deactivate bodies then `GetActiveBodiesUnsafe` is truly unsafe as it will be modified while iterating over the list.

It doesn't, and ideally should never. All it does is some force integration and the like, so it should be fine for now. It might become a bit of a pitfall as more changes start trickling in perhaps, but we'll cross that bridge when we get to it.
